name: Manikganj
queryAndRequestOutcome: Separate English and Bangla first-party discovery found the Government of Bangladesh DLRS/settlement.gov.bd cadastral-map custodian. The current viewer JavaScript was inspected and its public hierarchy and sheet GeoJSON route were called anonymously with browser headers, cookies, verified TLS, and bounded parameters. Manikganj district resolved, but the BDS survey response exposed Saturia and Singair entries rather than Manikganj Sadar. One Saturia sheet returned parcel-like EPSG:4326 polygons; it was not retained because it is not a verified Manikganj-city sample and stable native identity was not proven.

nativeFieldMapping.qualification: unproven stable native identity; not used in retained GeoJSON

compositeKeyProvenance.meaning: viewer request locator, not asserted as parcel identity

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identity if source-proven
full parcel polygon geometry if city-scoped
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point preserved; no coordinate shift.
No zero exact-point result or missing city hierarchy entry was treated as citywide absence.
District boundary and Saturia sheet geometry are not citywide evidence.
No raw source-specific attribute set or full parcel geometry was retained in the cohort.
At most three full parcel polygons would be allowed; retained count is zero.
Map-purchase portal indicates a paid/document-delivery route; terms were not inferred beyond the visible portal description.

qualification.reason: Official custodian and bounded parcel response are evidenced, but city-scoped coverage and stable native parcel identity remain unresolved.

uncertainty: Manikganj district has a first-party survey-map service, and the tested sheet endpoint is openly callable. The current BDS hierarchy may be incomplete/ongoing or may require another survey/administrative route for the city. No conclusion about parcel absence, completeness, or city coverage is justified.
